name: prototype
about: The dashboard prototype (prototype/dashboard/), each version on the brief's dashboard screens, on the frozen demo snapshot. Start it with pnpm proto:dev. Links name the version (#/<version>/), the scene (scene=, default afternoon), a still clock (still=1) and no Version control (shell=0). A direction item adds its own block of shots under its version's name.
